name: Least Squares Surface Simplification
definition: A simplification technique that finds the best-fit scalar field values for a coarser voxel level by minimizing the energy difference between the prolonged coarse field and the fine field, formulated as a least squares problem.
summary: Least Squares Surface Simplification reduces Sparse Voxel Octree resolution by optimizing scalar field values to minimize approximation error, distinguishing itself by explicitly optimizing accuracy rather than relying solely on structural sparsity.
